feed.title: Security Advisory for .NET packages hosted at the NuGet Gallery
feed.subtitle: Security Advisory for .NET packages hosted at the NuGet Gallery on GitHub

entry.title: [Magick.NET-Q8-x86] ImageMagick has a Use-After-Free when allocation in CheckPrimitiveExtent fails
entry.content:
When an allocation fails in CheckPrimitiveExtent this can result in a heap-use-after-free and result in a crash.

References

  • https://github.com/ImageMagick/ImageMagick/security/advisories/GHSA-px7q-ggqj-hcf2
  • https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-53462
  • https://github.com/dlemstra/Magick.NET/releases/tag/14.14.0
  • https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-px7q-ggqj-hcf2

entry.title: [Magick.NET-Q8-x86] ImageMagick has out-of-bounds write in ICON decoder due to incorrect loop
entry.content:
An incorrect loop in the ICON decoder can result in an out of bounds heap write resulting in a crash.

References
